title: Amelia evaluated at the Treffert Center

tellings.quote: you know the the tord center there you know because that's where darl trefford

plain: A girl named Amelia, one of the children said in the episode to be able to read minds, was reportedly evaluated in the 2020s at the Treffert Center in Wisconsin, named for the doctor Darold Treffert, who worked there. The researcher Diane Powell mentions it in passing, without naming a source. It is raised because a formal evaluation there would lend weight to claims about the girl's unusual abilities.
